a.name: Human condition
a.description: Wrote one eight-line poem, in two four-line stanzas, without AI assistance; rhyme was optional and there was no time limit (PDF p. 2).

a.name: Human-AI condition (editor)
a.description: Received a complete AI poem based on randomly chosen topical words. Could leave it unchanged, edit any line, select alternative AI lines, or delete it and start again; edited lines could trigger updated AI alternatives (PDF pp. 2-3).

a.name: AI condition (benchmark, no participants)
a.description: System-generated poems added to the expert rating set as a benchmark; no participants were assigned to this condition. No benchmark contrast is extracted (PDF pp. 2 and 4).

b.name: Human condition
b.description: Wrote an eight-line poem in two stanzas unassisted, with optional rhyme and no time limit.

b.name: Human-AI condition (editor)
b.description: Received a complete AI-generated poem based on randomly chosen topical words. Could leave it unchanged, edit it, or delete and rewrite it. The interface supplied alternative AI lines and updated alternatives in response to edits; no time limit.
